name: aspect-ratio
description: Select blocks with a maximum aspect ratio between fl and fu. The aspect ratio is the maximum edge length divided by the cube root of the volume. Other objects will be selected if they are associated with a block that matches the criterion.
notes: Live-checked on 3DEC 9.8.54 (2026-10-29): unit bricks match 'aspect-ratio 0 10', not 'aspect-ratio 5 10'.
